text:
maya (design): Dropping a compact thread about dark theme polish for the console. Main goals: make 1px chart strokes readable, avoid washed-out inline code, and standardize tiny-label copy (P95).

lee (frontend): Saw the mock. The big issue is the current pale-yellow inline code on some monitors. Also axis tick text at 11px lacks pop on non-linear gamma displays.

maya (design): Proposed swatches: background #071218, surface #0d1416, text-main #dbeef6 -> tweakable, inline-code-bg #08161a, inline-code-border #14323a. Chart series: S1 #61d3b8, S2 #5f8fff, S3 #ffb26b, S4 #ccb7ff.

zoe (product): Agree on S3 as warning. Also prefer copy update: change "95th perc" to "P95 latency" everywhere. Quick wins for customers.

omar (eng): For overlapping lines add a subtle halo: "stroke: rgba(0,0,0,0.16)" behind lines. For low-end GPUs disable glow via prefers-reduced-motion. Also we should ship an SVG hatch for critical alerts to aid color-blind users.

maya (design): CSS snippet to plug in: ```css :root[data-theme=\"dark\"]{--bg:#071218;--surface:#0d1416;--text:#dbeef6;--inline-code-bg:#08161a;--inline-code-border:#14323a;--s1:#61d3b8;--s2:#5f8fff;--s3:#ffb26b;--s4:#ccb7ff;} ```

aria-bot: Accessibility check started: contrast ratios, color-diff, focus-visible semantics. ETA ~7m. :robot_face:

aria-bot: Report: 3 flags -> 1) --text on .tiny-label fails 4.5:1, 2) series-pair #5f8fff vs #ccb7ff low contrast at 1px, 3) inline-code-border needs +1px strength on some displays.

maya (design): Actions: A) set tiny-label to #cbe6ee, B) nudge S4 to #bfb0ff, C) bump inline-code-border to #163d46. Also add default hatch for alert cells <=8px.

lee (frontend): I'll implement the vars and add a runtime check to enable hatch for small cells and high-contrast user setting. Will also add box-shadow focus ring: 0 0 0 4px rgba(135,192,255,0.14) + 1px inner accent for keyboard nav.

omar (eng): I'll include the prefers-reduced-motion guard for glows and add the SVG hatch asset. Minor perf note: avoid complex filters at high chart density.

zoe (product): Draft release blurb: "Dark theme: tightened chart palette, improved inline code legibility, P95 label polish, and accessibility patterns for color-difference users."

maya (design): Nice. I9ll push the updated swatches and hatch asset. Ping me if aria-bot still flags anything.

ar ia-bot: Re-run complete: all items resolved except pair contrast at <=1px on legacy monitors. Recommendation: render 1px as 1.5px on devices with devicePixelRatio=1 or enable hairline boost.

lee (frontend): I'll add a hairline boost fallback and open the PR. Thanks team.

zoe (product): TL;DR: ship if aria cleans up the last hairline issue. :thumbsup:
